prompt: Nowadays many people choose to be self-employed, rather than to work for a company or organisation. Why might this be the case? What could be the disadvantages of being self-employed?
essay:
In recent years, instead of working for a large employer, an increasing number of individuals have decided to work for their own business. This trend has become more popular in many countries. There are many factors or initiatives behind this decision that I would like to discuss as follows.

Firstly, I think folks tend to work for themselves mainly because it can provide a better work-life balance than big companies. The flexibility attracts many employees to quit their job for running their own business. Secondly, governments encourage local residents to build small businesses for economic development. As a result, those businesses become taxpayers to support the entire economic system. In addition, there are many financial benefits as a business owner, which stimulate him to build their own company. For example, they are allowed to reduce their taxable income for owning a company.

However, on the flip side, there are also some drawbacks to being a self-employed worker. For instance, some social benefits could fall under such as pension from a big employer to their employees, they need to save money for their future. Furthermore, their revenue would be unstable because it really depends on the market. If no one buys their products or services, it would be their own risk , leading to bankruptcy.

In conclusion, working as a self-employed person has been seen more regularly. The authority encourages certain person use their professional skills to build their own corporations, which is beneficial to both their own life and the community. But there are some disadvantages and risks that need to be avoided for beginners.
